'''Lazeria City''', also known simply as '''Lazeria''', was the largest [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lazerian IV]]. Lazeria City was located on the continent of [[Laz]] and was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Kingdom of Devit]].

==Description==
Lazeria city was a cosmopolitan [[City/Legends|city]] that housed around 40 million people around the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], five million of them being off-world visitors. Huge industrial complexes, which manufactured goods from imported raw materials were located in the outskirts of the city. These facilities were extremely efficient and produced little to no waste.<ref name="LIV" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained its embassy in Lazeria City, guarded by thirty-six [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and fourteen men of the [[King's Own Guard]]. Besides the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] himself, there was only a small staff of eight posted at the embassy. Of the 50,000 members of the New republic resistance, most of them were located in Lazeria City as well.<ref name="LIV" />
